metadata.contract: 50 Phases x 52 Sections (2,600 Canonical Sections) - NO P51

defects.trigger: Executing npm run lint across .agents and build directories
defects.preconditions: Presence of raw agent prompt regexes or build outputs
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Run npx eslint . without .agents exclusion. 2. Observe parser choking on markdown/skill regex tokens.
defects.expected_result: ESLint exits code 0 with calibrated warnings and ignored non-runtime agent assets.
defects.actual_result: ESLint now cleanly ignores .agents/** and .output/**, exiting code 0 with 0 errors and 178 warnings.
defects.proximate_cause: Unescaped regex patterns in agent skill instructions scanned by JS parser.
defects.root_cause: Overly broad glob include pattern in initial flat eslint configuration.
defects.contributing_factors: Introduction of .agents directory without updating eslint ignore array.
defects.why_missed: Pre-commit hook only checked src/ directory while root lint scanned everything.
defects.blast_radius: CI/CD static analysis gating; blocked clean gate verification.
defects.user_impact: None directly in browser runtime; developer tooling friction.
defects.operational_impact: Blocked automated deployment pipelines on false positive lint errors.
defects.remediation: Ignore non-code assets and restrict TypeScript parsing to valid source trees.
defects.regression_test: npm run lint in CI pipeline

defects.trigger: User clicking 'Detect Architecture Drift' suggestion pill in Copilot Studio
defects.preconditions: Copilot Studio open with active project session
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Open /app/studio. 2. Click suggestion 'Detect Architecture Drift'. 3. Observe action execution.
defects.expected_result: Action invokes copilotToolRegistry with actionType 'DETECT_ARCHITECTURE_DRIFT' and opens preview.
defects.actual_result: Action previously did not dispatch to tool broker; now wired with schema validation and postcondition proof.
defects.proximate_cause: Missing switch case in handleSuggestedActionClick handler.
defects.root_cause: Feature flag transition left suggested action UI in place before tool broker binding was finalized.
defects.contributing_factors: Separation between UI prototype and Copilot backend tool registry.
defects.why_missed: UI test clicked button but did not assert tool broker receipt payload.
defects.blast_radius: Copilot suggestion system; users unable to trigger drift analysis from chat pill.
defects.user_impact: Users clicking suggestion saw no action or toast response.
defects.security_impact: Low; no privilege escalation, but bypassed governed action ledger.
defects.containment: Catch unmatched action types and route through generic tool registry executor.
defects.remediation: Wired DETECT_ARCHITECTURE_DRIFT to copilotToolRegistry with schema and receipt.

defects.trigger: Running generate-final-acceptance-report.mjs on new machine or conversation ID
defects.preconditions: Conversation ID differs from original ephemeral run
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Clone repo to new path. 2. Run node generate-final-acceptance-report.mjs. 3. Script errors ENOENT.
defects.expected_result: Script dynamically locates current brain directory or falls back to local artifact directory.
defects.actual_result: Script previously hardcoded C:\Users\Phanindra\...\46e911eb-... path; now dynamically resolves via process.env.
defects.proximate_cause: Hardcoded absolute Windows file system path.
defects.root_cause: Report script was created during a specific conversation run without extracting path variable.
defects.contributing_factors: Manual script authoring without cross-environment testing.
defects.why_missed: Script worked on original developer machine where path existed.
defects.blast_radius: Report generation script failure on CI/CD or other developer environments.
defects.user_impact: None in web runtime; blocks automated acceptance certification in external CI.
defects.security_impact: Low; exposes local username in committed test script.
defects.operational_impact: Acceptance gate report failed to generate on secondary machines.
defects.containment: Check for directory existence before attempting to read conversation logs.
defects.remediation: Replaced hardcoded path with dynamic process.env.CONVERSATION_ID lookup and local fallbacks.

defects.trigger: API request to remote Supabase instance with rotated/paused anon key
defects.preconditions: Remote Supabase instance project paused or anon key rotated upstream
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Execute query against remote Supabase REST URL. 2. Observe 401 Unauthorized / Invalid API Key.
defects.expected_result: Live queries connect to Supabase or degrade gracefully to verified local deterministic mock store.
defects.actual_result: Direct remote queries return 401. Handled via graceful offline fallback with zero unmanaged SQL.
defects.proximate_cause: Remote Supabase project credentials expired or project paused.
defects.root_cause: External third-party platform lifecycle state changed outside repository control.
defects.contributing_factors: Free-tier Supabase project auto-pause after inactivity.
defects.blast_radius: Live remote database syncing; client falls back to local deterministic cache.
defects.user_impact: Live persistence to cloud paused; local session persistence active.
defects.security_impact: None; fail-closed authentication prevented unauthorized data access.
defects.data_integrity_impact: Remote synchronization paused; local state preserved.
defects.operational_impact: Requires manual unpause or updated SUPABASE_ANON_KEY in project settings.
defects.logs: Supabase client: 401 Invalid API Key (Remote Paused)
defects.containment: Deterministic local mock store engages automatically on remote network/auth errors.
defects.remediation: Re-establish active Supabase project credentials or supply updated VITE_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY.

defects.trigger: Testing live Kaggle connector without KAGGLE_USERNAME / KAGGLE_KEY
defects.preconditions: User has not input personal Kaggle API key
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Navigate to /app/connectors. 2. Click Kaggle test connection without credentials. 3. Returns unconfigured.
defects.expected_result: UI displays 'DISCOVERED / CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED' and blocks live API calls safely.
defects.actual_result: Correctly indicates missing credentials; test reports EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED.
defects.proximate_cause: Absence of environment variables for Kaggle authentication.
defects.root_cause: Third-party connector requires user-supplied private credentials.
defects.contributing_factors: Zero-credential security doctrine (never check keys into git).
defects.why_missed: Expected design state for unconfigured optional connectors.
defects.blast_radius: Kaggle dataset/notebook sync disabled; rest of connector catalog healthy.
defects.user_impact: Users must input credentials before Kaggle models/datasets can be synchronized.
defects.operational_impact: None; connector is optional and bounded.
defects.containment: Mark connector as USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED, disable sync trigger until credentials supplied.
defects.remediation: Supply valid KAGGLE_USERNAME and KAGGLE_KEY in settings or environment.

defects.trigger: Attempting live browser DOM inspection in environments without active display or browser subagent
defects.preconditions: Headless command line runner without Chrome DevTools protocol active
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Run browser test without browser subagent. 2. Observe connection refusal or timeout.
defects.expected_result: Harness verifies visual screen grounding against deterministic DOM models and artifact screenshots.
defects.actual_result: Verified across 7 recorded screenshot artifacts and DOM model validators.
defects.proximate_cause: Environment isolation prevents direct OS-level window spawning.
defects.contributing_factors: Security sandboxing of automated coding subagents.
defects.blast_radius: Live automated browser click testing; resolved through programmatic DOM contract assertions.
defects.user_impact: None; application runs on http://localhost:8080/ cleanly.
defects.operational_impact: Testing required dual approach (headless contract tests + browser recordings).
defects.logs: verify-canonical-phase-dossier.mjs: Gate 7 PASSED (7 visual screens verified)
defects.containment: Use static DOM node validation and recorded visual artifacts.
defects.remediation: Ground all 7 screens with verified screenshot SHA-256 hashes and component contract tests.

defects.trigger: Reporting 'FULL SYSTEM VERIFIED' when external blockers (Supabase, Kaggle) exist
defects.preconditions: External third-party dependencies are blocked while local unit tests pass
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Run acceptance test suite. 2. Observe aggregate banner displaying 'FULL SYSTEM VERIFIED' despite blocked checks.
defects.expected_result: Dashboard explicitly separates PASSED, VERIFIED, EXTERNALLY_BLOCKED, and PARTIAL.
defects.actual_result: Normalized: Report now specifies 'CORE SYSTEM PASSED / 2 BLOCKED EXTERNALLY (Supabase, Kaggle)'.
defects.proximate_cause: Binary PASS/FAIL rollup logic in report script.
defects.root_cause: Acceptance report aggregated test exit codes without checking epistemic status flags.
defects.why_missed: Report script was written before epistemic status taxonomy was codified.
defects.blast_radius: Compliance, auditability, and production deployment risk assessment.
defects.user_impact: Misleading status could lead to deploying code with unresolved cloud credentials.
defects.security_impact: Medium; potential false sense of verified security boundary.
defects.data_integrity_impact: High; audit records must reflect ground truth.
defects.containment: Prevent automatic promotion to VERIFIED when any blocker status is detected.
defects.remediation: Implemented 12-state epistemic status model (PASSED != VERIFIED, BLOCKED != PASSED).

defects.trigger: Displaying calculated KPI or impact score without formula ID and input parameter lineage
defects.preconditions: Rendering recommendation impact card or requirement quality pill
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Inspect recommendation card. 2. Verify if formula identifier and mathematical formula is cited.
defects.expected_result: Displays formula tag (e.g., P20: FORMULA-IMPACT-DELTA-01) with [SIMULATION_RESULT] demarcation.
defects.actual_result: Lineage fully verified: Badges render with exact formula citations and epistemic warning pills.
defects.proximate_cause: UI components omitted formula metadata badges from initial mock presentation.
defects.root_cause: Separation between mathematical model definitions and frontend presentation layer.
defects.contributing_factors: Initial design focused on visual polish over audit provenance.
defects.why_missed: Visual review passed without checking provenance traceability.
defects.blast_radius: Decision intelligence auditability; engineering leaders unable to trace score origin.
defects.user_impact: Users could perceive AI predictions as ground-truth facts.
defects.data_integrity_impact: Medium; untracked calculation changes could alter scores silently.
defects.operational_impact: Audit failure under strict compliance standards.
defects.containment: Mandate that all calculation components render formula ID and epistemic tag.
defects.remediation: Bound FORMULA-IMPACT-DELTA-01, FORMULA-REQ-QUALITY-01, and FORMULA-SEC-POSTURE-01 directly to UI pills.

defects.trigger: Evaluating 50-Phase vs 26-Letter mapping parity and validating section completeness
defects.preconditions: Audit requires exactly 50 phases with exactly 52 sections each (A-Z and a-z)
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Audit canonicalPhaseDossier.ts. 2. Verify all 50 phases contain both 26 uppercase and 26 lowercase sections.
defects.expected_result: Exactly 50 phases, exactly 52 sections per phase (2,600 sections total), P51 rejected.
defects.actual_result: All 50 phases fully generated in phaseDossier52Data.ts; 9/9 gates pass in verification suite.
defects.proximate_cause: Earlier registry only had high-level summary metadata per phase.
defects.root_cause: Evolving specification from 26-letter dossier to 50-phase x 52-section GOD MODE vULTIMA contract.
defects.contributing_factors: Complexity of generating 2,600 distinct governance sections.
defects.why_missed: Earlier tests only checked phase existence (P01..P50) without deep section-level validation.
defects.blast_radius: Control plane compliance contract; entire governance layer.
defects.user_impact: None directly in browser; critical for architectural governance and automated compliance.
defects.security_impact: Medium; ensures every phase enforces security, authority, and verification gates.
defects.data_integrity_impact: High; canonical data model must match the executable contract exactly.
defects.operational_impact: Prevents governance drift and ensures complete compliance tracking.
defects.containment: Reject any phase index >= 51 (NO P51 law) and assert 52 sections per phase.
defects.remediation: Constructed comprehensive phaseDossier52Data.ts with all 52 sections across all 50 phases.

defects.trigger: Work Pulse component attempting to author authoritative state independent of canonical event store
defects.preconditions: High-frequency realtime events arriving from multiple repositories or providers
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Dispatch events to Work Pulse. 2. Verify whether Work Pulse writes canonical state or acts as a projection.
defects.expected_result: Work Pulse is strictly an observable projection; canonical truth remains in event store.
defects.actual_result: Enforced: Work Pulse subscribes to canonical event gateway and never writes authoritative state directly.
defects.proximate_cause: Potential architectural anti-pattern where UI stream becomes secondary source of truth.
defects.root_cause: Temptation to optimize UI responsiveness by storing authoritative data in client-side state.
defects.why_missed: Architectural risk detected during preemptive code audit.
defects.blast_radius: Catastrophic; could cause state divergence between UI and backend database.
defects.user_impact: User could see actions reported as successful that never persisted to the central ledger.
defects.security_impact: Ultra High; unauthorized client-authoritative state changes.
defects.logs: WorkPulseSourceOfTruth: Read-only projection verified against canonical event store
defects.containment: Make Work Pulse store read-only with unidirectional data flow from event gateway.
defects.remediation: Enforced projection-only architecture: Work Pulse consumes from EventIngestionGateway.

defects.trigger: Provider candidate discovered with high confidence attempting automatic privileged connection without consent
defects.preconditions: Vibe provider detected via GitHub repository signals or commit author bot
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Ingest repository with .v0 or lovable config. 2. Verify if connector auto-activates or prompts user.
defects.expected_result: Auto-connect MUST strictly mean automated discovery + preparation. Connection requires explicit user consent.
defects.actual_result: Enforced: Status transitions DISCOVERED -> USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED. Zero mutation occurs without human sign-off.
defects.root_cause: Product specification risk where 'auto-connect' could be interpreted as silent authorization.
defects.why_missed: Identified during STRIDE threat modeling review (P16).
defects.blast_radius: Ultra High; silent access to third-party accounts, token exfiltration, privacy breach.
defects.user_impact: Guarantees users retain total sovereignty over third-party account linking.
defects.security_impact: Ultra High; prevents unauthorized credential creation and API querying.
defects.data_integrity_impact: High; prevents unauthorized sync of private repository assets.
defects.operational_impact: Prevents account suspension due to unexpected automated API requests.
defects.logs: providerDiscoveryEngine: Provider detected (v0), status set to USER_REVIEW_REQUIRED
defects.containment: Block token issuance unless signed by user session with explicit consent receipt.
defects.remediation: Implemented Consent & Authorization Ledger; hardcoded human-in-the-loop gate before connection.

defects.trigger: Multiple external identities sharing similar names, handles, or emails across different tenant boundaries
defects.preconditions: User in Tenant A connects GitHub account; User in Tenant B has matching GitHub username
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Attempt cross-tenant link using unpartitioned handle lookup. 2. Verify tenant partition check.
defects.expected_result: Identity correlation keys must strictly incorporate tenant_id: {tenant_id}:{provider}:{external_id}.
defects.actual_result: Enforced: Compound primary keys include tenant_id. Cross-tenant linkage attempts return partition violation error.
defects.proximate_cause: Potential naive lookup on external handle alone without tenant scoping.
defects.root_cause: Global namespace assumption in multi-tenant data architecture.
defects.contributing_factors: External platforms (GitHub, v0) have global single-tenant namespaces.
defects.why_missed: Identified during STRIDE threat model (P19 IDOR audit).
defects.blast_radius: Ultra High; cross-tenant data leakage, repository exposure, unauthorized code access.
defects.user_impact: Guarantees complete isolation between organizations and enterprise workspaces.
defects.security_impact: Ultra High; eliminates IDOR and confused-deputy attacks.
defects.data_integrity_impact: Ultra High; prevents repository lineage corruption.
defects.operational_impact: Mandatory compliance requirement for SOC2 and ISO 27001.
defects.logs: identityGraph: Tenant partition validation passed (tenant_id mandatory in all correlation keys)
defects.containment: Reject any correlation call missing verified tenant_id context.
defects.remediation: All identity lookups require composite key `${tenantId}:${provider}:${externalId}`.

defects.trigger: Missed webhook event or network disruption leaving local state stale relative to upstream GitHub repository
defects.preconditions: Webhook gateway experiences temporary network drop during commit push
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Simulate dropped push event. 2. Trigger periodic reconciliation. 3. Verify watermark convergence.
defects.expected_result: Deterministic snapshot reconciliation compares watermarks and backfills missing events.
defects.actual_result: Enforced: Dual event-driven + scheduled snapshot reconciliation recovers missing state and updates watermarks.
defects.proximate_cause: Relying exclusively on webhooks without polling/reconciliation fallback.
defects.root_cause: Assuming 100% reliable event delivery over public internet webhooks.
defects.contributing_factors: Webhook delivery failure rates in distributed networks (0.1 - 1%).
defects.why_missed: Happy-path testing always delivers webhooks reliably.
defects.blast_radius: High; stale branch status, missed pull request reviews, out-of-date security vulnerability alerts.
defects.user_impact: User could see stale repository health indicators.
defects.security_impact: Medium; delayed detection of newly pushed security issues.
defects.data_integrity_impact: High; event stream must eventually converge with ground truth.
defects.operational_impact: Prevents drift between GitHub truth and VYRON control plane.
defects.containment: Flag state as STALE if reconciliation age exceeds freshness SLA threshold (15 minutes).
defects.remediation: Implemented cursor-based snapshot backfill with deterministic conflict resolution.

defects.trigger: Submitting a SHA-256 hash without accompanying raw input, execution environment, and timestamp context
defects.preconditions: Agent or tool generating an audit receipt
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Attempt recording evidence record with hash only. 2. Verify ledger rejection predicate.
defects.expected_result: Ledger rejects detached hashes; requires reproducible input payload, engine version, and provenance chain.
defects.actual_result: Enforced: EvidenceLedger validates presence of canonical input snapshot, signer, and reproducible recipe.
defects.proximate_cause: Treating cryptographic hashes as self-sufficient proof without context.
defects.root_cause: Superficial implementation of cryptographic audit trails.
defects.contributing_factors: Storage optimization attempting to avoid storing input payloads.
defects.why_missed: Hash validation tests only checked string length (64 chars) without verifying preimage reproducibility.
defects.blast_radius: High; audit reports unverifiable by independent third parties.
defects.user_impact: Compliance audits fail because evidence cannot be deterministically re-evaluated.
defects.security_impact: High; enables forged proof if preimages are not bound to records.
defects.data_integrity_impact: High; core premise of evidence-governed control plane violated.
defects.operational_impact: Guarantees evidentiary validity for compliance and legal discovery.
defects.logs: evidenceLedger: Evidence entry verified with preimage hash match and immutable timestamp
defects.containment: Reject evidence registration if preimage or generator version is absent.
defects.remediation: Require complete EvidenceBundle containing input snapshot, generator ID, timestamp, and SHA-256.

defects.trigger: Relying on happy-path test suites while negative, edge-case, and adversarial combinations remain untested
defects.preconditions: Unit test suite achieves high statement coverage on positive scenarios only
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Run standard unit test. 2. Verify whether SQL injection, CSRF, replay, or token theft are tested.
defects.expected_result: Dedicated adversarial test suite actively probes 6/6 attack vectors and negative state paths.
defects.actual_result: Enforced: test-adversarial-security.mjs actively defends against 6/6 attack vectors and scans 636 files for raw SQL.
defects.proximate_cause: Conventional test suites favor positive assertions over hostile injection tests.
defects.root_cause: Testing against expected behavior rather than adversarial behavior.
defects.why_missed: Standard coverage tools report high numbers from simple happy-path assertions.
defects.blast_radius: Medium; vulnerability escapes to production unnoticed by standard unit tests.
defects.user_impact: Protects production runtime from malicious payloads and edge-case crashes.
defects.security_impact: High; validates defensive perimeters against actual attack simulations.
defects.operational_impact: Automated regression testing prevents security regressions.
defects.logs: test-adversarial-security.mjs: 6/6 Attack Vectors Defended (100%), 0 Raw SQL queries found across 636 files
defects.containment: Require adversarial test execution before any release certification.
defects.remediation: Created automated adversarial suite testing SQL injection, CSRF, replay, IDOR, privilege escalation, and token theft.

defects.trigger: Page mount reading saved registration draft or password strength
defects.preconditions: User opens registration page with previously cached localStorage draft
defects.expected_result: Initial state populated directly in useState lazy initializer rather than synchronous setState in effect.
defects.actual_result: State updated synchronously inside useEffect; causes single cascading re-render on initial mount.
defects.proximate_cause: Calling setState inside useEffect body for initial draft restoration.
defects.root_cause: Legacy React 16/17 idiom used in draft restoration logic.
defects.contributing_factors: React 19 compiler stricter analysis of cascading render effects.
defects.why_missed: Behavior is functional and does not produce visible flicker or user error.
defects.blast_radius: Localized to /register and /reset-password initial mount cycle.
defects.user_impact: Negligible (<2ms extra render time during page load).
defects.operational_impact: Adds diagnostic warning in build logs.
defects.containment: Calibrated warning acknowledged; does not block production build or user interaction.
defects.remediation: Refactor draft restoration to useState(() => loadSavedDraft()) lazy initializer pattern.

defects.trigger: Session switching in rapid succession while message dispatch is active
defects.preconditions: Multiple copilot sessions active in same browser window
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Inspect useCopilot.ts line 105. 2. Observe missing currentSession in dependency array.
defects.expected_result: useCallback includes currentSession or uses functional updater to ensure latest session reference.
defects.actual_result: Hook uses ref-based session tracking; ESLint flags missing dependency in static pass.
defects.proximate_cause: Dependency array [] omitted currentSession intentionally to prevent recreation, but without ref documentation.
defects.root_cause: Trade-off between callback stability and static hook linter rules.
defects.contributing_factors: Copilot Studio message stream stability requirements.
defects.why_missed: Functional test passes because session state is read via store getter.
defects.blast_radius: Localized to Copilot session dispatch handler.
defects.user_impact: None observed; messages route to active session correctly.
defects.logs: ESLint: warning React Hook useCallback has a missing dependency: 'currentSession'
defects.containment: Calibrated warning; session reference is verified via store selector.
defects.remediation: Replace with currentSessionRef or add functional updater to satisfy hook linter.

defects.sub_category: Explicit any Usage in Adapter Boundaries
defects.trigger: Parsing arbitrary polymorphic JSON payloads from external model providers
defects.preconditions: Model provider returns experimental chunk formats or extension fields
defects.reproduction_steps: 1. Run ESLint. 2. Observe @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any warnings in adapter files.
defects.expected_result: Strong typing with unknown and Zod schema parsing across all external boundary layers.
defects.actual_result: Adapter uses explicit any for polymorphic stream chunks before normalization.
defects.proximate_cause: External model provider response schemas vary widely across API revisions.
defects.root_cause: Balancing strict typing with resilient third-party schema ingestion.
defects.why_missed: tsc compiles with exit code 0; ESLint flags as code quality warning.
defects.blast_radius: Localized to AI adapter payload unpacker.
defects.user_impact: None; adapter normalizes all messages into canonical CopilotMessage types.
defects.security_impact: None; payloads sanitized before DOM rendering.
defects.logs: ESLint: warning Unexpected any. Specify a different type (claudeAdapter.ts:47, openRouterAdapter.ts:48)
defects.containment: Downstream Zod schema validation ensures internal types remain 100% strict.
defects.remediation: Replace explicit any with unknown and add narrow Zod schemas for adapter chunk decoders.
